$doc: The worked checks-config for consumer #1 (quartermaster as-if-template-built; plan app-templates-2026-07-04 P-007/P-013). Schema: @papercusp/template-kit TemplateChecksConfig. REALIZED (P-013): materialized in the quartermaster repo as packages/template-checks/ (checks-config.json with app.root '../..' + the four portable check files copied verbatim + DECISIONS.md disclosure; run via `npm run template-checks` at the qm root) — keep THIS file and that one in sync. app.root='.' here means 'place beside the app repo root'. boot.mode is 'attach' because ~/.quartermaster/operator.json is a per-user singleton — use 'spawn' with a command only on a machine with NO live quartermaster. Pinned by template-kit's checks-config tests (edit both sides).

components.$doc: P-022 (agentic-desktop-app re-layered onto the desktop-app base): the composition's npm-visible component pins. PATTERN components map to app-local packages (embedded-postgres-server -> @quartermaster/embedded-postgres-server; typed-contracts -> @quartermaster/contracts); papergrid is a META-package so the app depends on the SUB-package it uses (@papercusp/grid-core); lexicon is DROPPED per the ui template's ui-surfaces decision point (see DECISIONS.md).
